architectural_notes: Yearly progress chart uses existing daily recorded data aggregated into monthly totals for the current calendar year (Jan–Dec).
Total Time metric should be converted to hours before charting.

existing_features.title: Add a new "Yearly Progress" chart section above the existing "Monthly Volume Summary" in the Becoming view.
Render the yearly progress chart as a responsive grouped bar chart with Jan–Dec on the x-axis and an automatically scaled y-axis based on the computed monthly totals.
Compute chart data from the existing saved daily habit data by aggregating all habits into monthly totals for (a) Total Reps and (b) Total Time converted to hours for each month (Jan–Dec).
Style the chart section with a clean modern aesthetic consistent with the current UI and using blue and gray tones, and include a clear legend identifying "Total Reps" and "Total Time (hours)".
Limit the yearly progress chart to the current calendar year only (no year switching UI).

new_feature_requests.summary: Add responsive yearly progress bar chart above Monthly Volume Summary showing Jan–Dec monthly totals for Total Reps and Total Time (hours), with blue/gray modern styling, legend, and auto-scaling y-axis (current year only; aggregated from existing daily saved data).

projectName: Add responsive yearly progress bar chart above Monthly Volume Summary
